digest.component_or_area: LLM workflow and plan review modules
propositions: Nine modules are at or within 20 lines of the 800-LOC cap; gate_dispatch.py has only 1 line of headroom and is blocking story 343b's gap-5 change which requires adding one parameter to three finalize_verdict call sites in that file

Extracting the plan-review recovery cluster (STEP_* constants, GateContractError, collection/validation helpers, metrics attachment, failure recovery functions) from gate_dispatch.py into a new plan_review_recovery.py module reduces gate_dispatch from 799 to 527 LOC and creates 271 lines of headroom

Extracting the context-assembly cluster (assemble_cache, assemble_context_cache, related helpers) from orchestrator.py into a new context_assembly.py module reduces orchestrator from 796 to 646 LOC and creates 154 lines of headroom for 343b's parameter addition
Both extracted modules (323 and 194 LOC) exceed the 100-LOC anti-fragmentation floor, and the splits follow existing call-graph seams with zero test edits required

The code-review gate cluster in gate_dispatch is not extracted in this ticket because its sole internal caller is monkeypatched by string at 14 external sites; moving it would silently break those patches without a separate design change
